system.name: VaLR
system.one_liner: Vision-aligned Latent Reasoning: an MLLM generates latent tokens before each reasoning step, trained to align its intermediate features with an external vision encoder.

content.variant_note: one tall LLM drawn once with its token sequence unrolled along the bottom edge for two reasoning rounds, plus a training-only alignment branch in a wedge-shaped panel tied to one hatched layer
content.argues: Feeding vision-aligned latent tokens before each reasoning step keeps visual information alive during long generation, and the alignment to an external encoder is needed only at training time.
content.subject: A tall MLLM unrolled over image, question, latent and language tokens for two reasoning rounds, plus a training-only alignment branch.

elements.name: MLP

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a latent-token scheme by unrolling the token sequence along the bottom of one tall model, colour tokens by type and show the feedback as thick arrows from output hidden states back to the next input slots; attach the training-only branch as a wedge-shaped panel running back to the one hatched layer it reads.
lessons.suits: models that feed their own hidden states back as inputs, or that add a training-only auxiliary branch tied to one intermediate layer.

evidence: During latent token generation, the last hidden states of MLLM becomes input embedding for the next token prediction
Note that we do not use the external vision encoder at test-time.

summary: VaLR (Vision-aligned Latent Reasoning) makes a multimodal LLM generate vision-aligned latent tokens before each chain-of-thought step so that visual information is not diluted during long reasoning. Figure 1 has two lettered parts. In (a), a tall mint-tinted LLM of four Transformer Block bars is drawn once, with its token sequence unrolled along the bottom edge: image tokens from a frozen Vision Encoder, question tokens, cream latent tokens and language tokens; thick teal arrows carry each round's last hidden states H back down as the next input embeddings, and LM Heads at the top emit the quoted sentences. In (b), a wedge-shaped panel from the hatched middle block shows intermediate features f passed through Upsample and an MLP and aligned (Alignment Loss) with features from a frozen External Vision Encoder, marked Training-time only.
summary_zh: VaLR 让多模态大模型在每步思维链前先生成与视觉对齐的潜在 token。图分 (a)(b)：(a) 底部展开 token 序列的 LLM，粗箭头把末层隐状态回送为输入；(b) 楔形面板把中间层特征对齐外部视觉编码器，仅训练时用。
notes: The text layer holds stale hidden strings from another figure (UNet Model / Distill v4, Multi-View Diffusion Model, Generated View) that do not appear in the print; the prior merged tag title-branding is therefore not supported by the printed figure. The feature pictures in panel (b) are read as PCA-style feature visualisations; the figure does not say what they are. The grey tokens after each latent block are read as language tokens of the reasoning step; the figure does not label them.
